summary: SOCRadar Attack Surface Management Essential: it continuously searches the internet for everything the company owns and keeps an inventory of those assets.
value: It shows company domains, sites, IPs, services and cloud storage reachable from outside.
Forgotten resources are found before an attacker finds them.
The attack surface map updates itself.
simple: Continuously searches the internet for everything the company owns: domains, websites, IP addresses, services, cloud storage, code repositories — and keeps an inventory of these assets with an attack surface map. Finds misconfigurations in email, DNS, SSL certificates, websites and cloud, information leaks and open ports; passively checks for vulnerabilities and prioritizes risks. Scans once a month.
notIncluded: Extended features and volumes come with Business and Ultimate.
